correctness.rationale: The Gaussian quasi-radial indicator E={|z1|>|z2|} is diagonal in orthonormal monomials, with eigenvalues binomial CDF lambda_nm=2^-(n+m+1)sum_{j<=n}binom(n+m+1,j). The multiplication commutator has orthogonal shift images with weights sqrt(n+1)*binom(n+m+1,n+1)/2^(n+m+2), so its bounded extension exists. Maximizing over shell levels for a=n+1 gives sqrt(a)*binom(2a,a)/(2*4^a), strictly increasing to 1/(2sqrt(pi)); every weight strictly smaller, giving norm nonattainment, and weakly-null maximizing basis vectors give equal essential norm. The per-shell trace of T(I-T) is (1/2)E|B-Bprime| for independent Bin(k,1/2), namely k*binom(2k,k)/(2*4^k); induction telescopes all shells to the exact total-degree cutoff formula and Stirling yields N^1.5/(3sqrt(pi)). Independent exact Fraction calculations checked 16 trace cutoffs.
